d:
Yu is being prepared, as it has been for generations in almost every household of this Meitei village. The fermentation and distillation of rice produces the traditional alcoholic beverage. Andro is one of the villages known for the locally made brew.
Yu is no quick-fix intoxicant or merely a side-gig. Rice wine and beer are an essential part of religious rituals and community life in Andro.
That quiet routine came to a sudden halt this past week, when 17 people died after consuming spurious liquor in the neighbouring districts of Chandel and Kakching.
